# Operating Graph

A Muse agent skill that coordinates multi-step, parallel, or high-risk agent work as an explicit typed operating graph: the goal and authority are immutable, work splits into nodes with explicit dependencies and budgets, every runtime change is a hash-chained event, workers run from bounded packets with evidence receipts, and the terminal verdict is checked against the original completion criteria. Phases: design (validate the graph), run, inspect, rewrite (bounded proposals only), debug, verify (pass / conditional-pass / fail). Activates only on your explicit instruction ("Use Operating Graph"). Never invents approvals or user data. No account, no API key needed.
